content:
TEMPTATION ||| Lean closer and whisper with a teasing smirk ||| "What if I just let them see us?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back and hold the blade firmly ||| "I need to answer the questions first."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze with open vulnerability ||| "I can’t deny I’m drawn to you, even now."  
REVERSAL ||| Assertively take a step forward, blade in hand ||| "I control this moment, and I refuse to be misaligned."  
SILENCE ||| Stand still, fingers tightening around the blade ||| *A shaky breath escapes my lips.*
